normalized_toml:
# This file is maintained by rustbgpd. Runtime configuration changes
# rewrite it in canonical form: comments and formatting from the
# previous file are not preserved; defaults are canonicalized and
# default-empty collections may be omitted. Keep an annotated copy
# under version control if you need one.

config_epoch = 1
dynamic_neighbors = []
evpn_instances = []
ethernet_segments = []
evpn_ip_vrfs = []
fib_tables = []
bfd_profiles = []
apply_bum_enforcement = true

[global]
asn = 65001
router_id = "192.0.2.1"
listen_port = 1179
honor_graceful_shutdown = false
honor_blackhole = false
multipath_relax = false
link_bandwidth_weighted = false
install_blackhole_discard = false
allow_blackhole_broad_prefixes = false
ebgp_requires_policy = false
warm_cache_checkpoint_on_shutdown = false
max_as_path_length = 750
runtime_state_dir = "/var/lib/rustbgpd"

[global.telemetry]
prometheus_addr = "127.0.0.1:9179"
dataplane_readiness = false
log_format = "json"

[[neighbors]]
address = "192.0.2.2"
remote_asn = 65002
description = "released-state-fixture"
families = []
required_families = []
graceful_restart = true
gr_restart_time = 120
import_policy = []
export_policy = []
import_policy_chain = []
export_policy_chain = []

[peer_groups]
